tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khrid chen brgyad mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// khrid chen brgyad kyi mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba/ dpal 'brug pa yab sras kyi zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dul zhing nyer zhi rtag tu dran ldan pa'i// 'jig rten mgon po skyabs mchog bla med pa// thub dbang rjes skyes sras bcas thams cad dang*// gnyis med dkar brgyud de la phyag 'tshal lo// legs byas thabs tshul sna tshogs 'od zer gyis// 'gro 'di'i rmongs pa'i mun pa mthar 'byin pa'i// dpal ldan 'jigs med bdud las rgyal ba yi// bshes gnyen bla ma de yis 'dir srungs shig /'di na 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor chos kyi rdzings// sbyar ba lta ngan rlung gis bskyod pa yis// log sde srin mo'i gling 'khyams shes ldan 'ga'// theg mchog cang shes 'di zhon 'bros par gyis// skye bo phal cher mya ngam thang chen por// chos min smig rgyu'i rjes 'brang ngal gyur pa// de dag zab rgyas gting mtha' mi dpogs pa'i// chos mtsho 'di 'thungs mngon par tshim par byos/ 'dir gangs can gyi ljongs kyi grub pa'i ring lugs pa chen po dpal 'brug pa zhes grags pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug rnams kyis sku nyams su bstar ba'i khrid chen po brgyad po 'di dag skyes bu skal ba bzang po rnams kyis spyod pa'i yul du gyur pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi snying po gsal bar ston pa'o// de 'chad pa la nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig brjod pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang bla ma mos gus dang*/ phyag chen dang*/ nā ro pa chen po'i chos drug dang*/ gsang spyod bzlog sgom gyi khrid dag dang po nas rgyas par bzhugs la/ phyi ma rnams rje 'gro ba'i mgon po rgya ras pa nyid kyi rtsa ba tsam zhig mdzad/ de las rgyas par rgyal ba rgod tshang pas mdzad/ de las kyang ches cher rgyas par rgyal ba yang dgon pa dang*/ grub thob chen po o ṭi ya ṇa pa rin chen dpal la sogs pas mdzad do// 'dir dpal rgyal ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa zab gnad dang*/

legs par bshad pa ches mang bar snang ba las/ brgyud pa la'ang 'di nyid gdan rabs gtso che bar gzung na legs par mngon no// gzhan yang phyag chen gyi brgyud pa/ dkar brgyud 'di nyid kyi chos srid kyi sbyor bas phun sum tshogs pa'i bla ma dag /nā ro pa nas/ ḍombi pa/ jo bo rje de'i slob ma dgon pa ba las rim par brgyud de dwags pos gsan zhes tshig brgyud dang*/ don brgyud nā ro pa nas mar pa dang*/ mi la dwags po yin zhes brjod/ de la kho bo cag 'di skad du smra ste/ de ltar na smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po sa skya paṇḍita kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyis/ chos drug bor nas lam 'bras dang*// phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa// gzhan gyi gdam ngag sgom bzhin du// nā ro'i brgyud pa 'ded byed pa// gzhan dang 'gal ba lta ci smos// rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin// zhes gsungs pa la lan gdab tu med do// gzhan yang la la dag /phyag rgya chen po mdo'i phyogs kyi man ngag yin no snyam du sems shing*/ gzhan dag la'ang brjod par byed do// de ltar na khyed cag nyid kyi bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi ta'i gsung las lta sgom dbu ma las lhag pa med par smra ba la skyon du blta zhing*/ dgag pa ltar bcos pa'i tshig 'ga' zhig gi 'dom gyis mkhas pa'i dgongs pa nam mkha' lta bu la 'jal bar byed pas na rnam dpyod kyis dben par 'jal lo// gzhan yang de skad du smra ba ni/ bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres zhes pa'i don la nges pa ma rnyed pa lta ci smos te/ nges pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa yin no// de tsam du ma zad lta ba khas len dang bral ba zhes rang stong pa kho na ltar bshad nas/ bdag cag dkar brgyud rin po che'i lta ba ni 'di yin la/ gzhan bshad pa po phal che bas bshad pa ni log pa'o zhes smra ba ni// rdo rje theg pa chen po bla na med pa la nges pa ma dmigs pa'o// bdag ni phyag rgya chen po gsang sngags kyi rdzogs rim mtshan nyid pa dang*/

brgyud pa rje mi la nas brgyud par khas len no// de la rgyu mtshan med par smra na/ snga ma ni dkar brgyud 'di nyid kyi bla ma dam pa phal mo che bzhed/ phyi ma ni phag mo grub pa'i phyag chen tshigs bcad ma las bshad/ de las rgyas par bdag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po dpal ngag gi dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyis/ mdo rgyud kyi lung rgya chen pos bsgrub par mdzad pa dang*/ mtshungs med rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bshad pa las 'dir mangs kyi dogs nas ma spros so// de bas na bshad par bya ba de dag gi sa bcad tsam zhig brjod pas phyi rabs pa rnams 'jug pa bde bar 'gyur ba de nyid kyi ched du bshad pa/ byin rlabs thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa thams cad kyi snying po/ bla ma mos gus kyi khrid la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po la/ bla ma tshogs zhing du byas nas manḍal 'bul ba/ bla ma rigs bdag tu byas nas sdig sgrib sbyang ba/ bla ma skyabs gnas su byas nas gsol ba 'debs pa/ bla ma rang sems dang bsres te/ bar chad sel ba dang bzhi'o// dang po la/ bsgrub pa'i manḍal dang mchod pa'i manḍal lo// gsum pa la/ phyi'i gsol 'debs kyi rgyud sbyang ba dang*/ nang gi gsol 'debs kyi byin dbab pa'o// de la ring brgyud khrom tshogs su bsgom pa dang*/ nye brgyud mtho brtsegs su bsgom pa dang*/ kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgom pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ smin byed dbang dang*/ dbang don nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la/ rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum mo// gnyis pa la/ mos pa lam byed sprul sku'i lam khyer/ rnam pa lam byed longs sku'i lam khyer/ mngon sum lam byed chos sku'i lam khyer ro// gnyis pa la rags pa lha sku la bslab pa/ 'bring po phyag mtshan la bslab pa/ phra ba sa bon la bslab pa'o// gsum pa la/ rang sems bla ma chos sku la sgro 'dogs bcad/

rnam pa bla ma chos sku la rtsal sbyang*/ snang srid bla ma chos sku'i ngo bor rdzogs par bya'o// de dag gi nyams len 'dir 'du ste/ mos pa lam byed sprul sku'i lam khyer gyis bla ma sprul pa'i skur bsgrub pa/ rnam pa lam byed longs sku'i lam khyer gyi gnad kyis bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bsgrub pa/ mngon sum lam byed chos sku'i lam khyer gyi gnad kyis bla ma chos skur bsgrub pa'o// de la dang po phyi bsgrub/ gnyis pa nang bsgrub/ gsum pa gsang ba'i bsgrub pa yin la sngon du 'gro ba bzhi par bla ma 'phrin las bzhi pa'i las sbyor dang sbyar te bshad dgos so// gsung rab chu bo ji snyed pa// mngon par 'bab pa zab mo'i lam// mos gus ma dros mtsho 'dir ni// skal bzang klu dbang dgyes spyod cig /gang gis ring gnas thob dka' ba'i// mgon po tshe 'dir sgrub pa'i thabs// bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'di bkod pas// shes ldan bag yod brten par rigs// zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// gnyis pa tha mal gyi shes rgyud yang dag pa'i ye shes su ngo sprod par byed pa phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'o// gnyis pa la'ang thun mong gi nyams len dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len no// dang po la/ sgom gyi rtsa ba zhi gnas kyi nyams btsal te rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba dang*/ gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba bcad de lhag mthong ngos gzung nas spros bral gyi rnam 'byor bsgom pa'o// dang po la/ thol skyes rbad gcod/ gang shar bzo med/ gzhag thabs kyi gnad do// gnyis pa la/ gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba bcad pa/ lhag mthong ngos gzung ba/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'o// de la dus gsum gyi sgo nas dpyad pa/ dngos po dngos med kyi sgo nas dpyad pa/

gcig tha dad kyi sgo nas dpyad pa'o/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len la/ chos thams cad snang sems dbyer med kyi sgo nas zung 'jug tu ro gcig pas ro gcig gi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa dang*/ chos thams cad gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi skur gtan la phab nas sgom med kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'o// dang po la/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dpes snang ba sems su ngo sprad pa dang*/ chu dang chab rom gyi dpes snang stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprad pa dang*/ chu dang rlabs kyi dpes chos thams cad ro mnyam tu gtan la 'bebs pa'o// gsum pa rjes la phyag rgya chen po ngos gzung zhing rang ngo sprad pa/ gegs dang gol shor bcad cing nyams rtogs go ba gsum gyis shan dbye ba/ 'bras bu sku gsum gyi thob tshul bstan pa'o// de dag gi nyams len thams cad 'dir 'dus te/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku'i gnad kyis lta ba gtan la dbab pa/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa rang 'od gzugs sku'i gnad kyis sgom pa nyams su blang ba/ snang srid lhan cig skyes pa dbyer med kyi gnad kyis 'bras bu mthar phyin par bya ba'o// phal cher gnyis su 'dzin cing 'gal ba'i chos// ro mnyam nyid du 'jal byed tshad ma gang*// grub pa mchog gis mngon sum gzigs pa yi// tshul der spyod la spro ba 'dir zhugs shig /ces kyang smras so// gsum pa rdo rje'i lus la rlung sems kyi rten 'brel gnad du bsnun pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang dbang med par mngon sum du ster bar byed pa thabs lam khyad par can gyi khrid la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// gnyis pa la/ gtum mo/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ bar do/ 'pho ba dang drug go /dang po la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la/ phyi lus kyi stong ra/ nang rtsa'i stong ra/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ rtsa lam sbyang ba/ rtsa gnas byin gyis brlab pa dang lnga'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/

lus kyi gnad me thab drug chings/ ngag gi gnad sbyor ba bzhi ldan/ sems kyi gnad gtum mo rnam gsum mo// de la las gyi gtum mo// nyams kyi gtum mo// mchog gi gtum mo'o// gsum pa rjes la/ drod kyi bogs 'don rtsub shing ma dang*/ bde ba'i bogs 'don a haṃ gi 'bar 'dzag go /de la rang lus thabs ldan dang*/ gzhan lus shes rab bo// dang po la/ sngon 'gro yid rig /dngos gzhi 'bar 'dzag go /gnyis pa sgyu lus la/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba spyi don gyi sgyu ma/ dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba sbas don gyi sgyu ma/ gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad sgyu mar sbyang ba mthar thug gi sgyu ma'o// gsum pa rmi lam la/ rmi lam gzung ba/ sbyang zhing sgyu mar bslab pa/ rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid la rtsal sbyang ba/ dang po la/ 'dun pa'i stobs kyis gzung ba/ rlung gi stobs kyis gzung ba/ dmigs pa'i stobs kyis gzung ba'o// bzhi pa 'od gsal la gsum ste/ gzhi'i 'od gsal/ lam gyi 'od gsal/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal lo// gnyis pa la/ nyin snang lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba/ mtshan snang lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba/ bar do lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba'o// lnga pa bar do la/ rang bzhin dag pa chos sku'i lam khyer/ rnam pa dag pa longs sku'i lam khyer/ byed las dag pa sprul sku'i lam khyer/ ro mnyam dag pa ngo bo nyid sku'i lam khyer ro// drug pa 'pho ba la/ rab chos skur 'pho ba/ 'bring longs skur 'pho ba/ tha ma skye ba 'dzin pa'i 'pho ba'o// chos drug po de dag kyang bsre ba gsum du 'dus pa yin te/ nyin snang lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba'i gnad kyis/ gtum mo dang sgyu lus sprul sku'i lam khyer// mtshan snang lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba'i gnad kyis 'od gsal dang rmi lam chos sku'i lam khyer// bar do lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba'i gnad kyis bar do dang 'pho ba longs sku'i lam khyer dang gsum po 'dir 'dus so// rgyud sde mchog gi snying po'i snying po gang*// legs par gzigs nas gzhan la 'doms mdzad pa// rje btsun nā ro'i gdams ngag 'di bshad pas// 'gro rnams bde bar gshegs pa'i sa thob shog

/ces so// bzhi pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad grogs su khyer zhing*/ mthun rkyen thams cad lam du longs shing bar chad thams cad dngos grub tu sdud par byed pa'i gnad ma nor ba gsang spyod bzlog bsgom gyi khrid la bzhi ste/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang*/ gsang ba'i spyod pa dang*/ tshogs kyi spyod pa dang*/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa'o// gnyis pa la gnas gang du 'gro ba/ grogs gang dang 'grogs nas 'gro ba/ dus nam 'gro ba/ spyod lam ji lta bus 'gro ba dang bzhi'o// de la dbang po rab kyi nyams len/ 'bring gi nyams len/ dbang po tha ma'i nyams len no// dang po la/ gzhi lta ba'i go cha/ rkyen bla ma'i mos gus/ dmigs pa bsgom pa'i mtshon cha'o// gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro 'dun pa btang ba/ dngos gzhi stong nyid kyi ngang la bzhag pa/ rjes ro mnyam pa'o// gsum pa la/ rang don rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyong*/ gzhan don snying rje'i rtsal sbyong*/ thun mong du chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa'o// de dag las spyod pa gzhan gsum shugs bstan dang*/ gsang spyod bstan bya'i gtso bo yin la/ de'i nyams len mdor bsdu na gcer nyal 'khrig med kyi gnad kyis gdon chos kyi skur gtan la 'bebs pa lta ba'i thag chod/ phung po tshogs 'khor gyi gnad kyis gdon longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur rtsal sbyong bsgom pa'i lam longs/ phung po gzan sgyur gyi gnad kyis gdon sprul pa'i skur lta ba spyod pa'i bogs 'don dang gsum du 'dus so// grub pa mchog rnams gshegs pa'i lam chen po// gsang chen kun tu spyod pa 'dir zhugs na// mchog gi sa la 'bad pa med par yang*// bgrod 'gyur skal bzang rnams kyis brten par byos// zhes smras so// lnga pa zab mo dag snang zhing sbyong gi khrid la gtso bor sngags kyi theg pa dang mthun pa zhing sku gsum du sbyang ba/ zhar byung thun mong theg pa dang mthun pa zhing brgyud pa'i sgo nas sbyang ba'o// dang po la/

ngo bo'i sgo nas chos sku yin tshul/ rnam pa'i sgo nas longs skur 'char tshul/ byed las kyi sgo nas sprul skur grub tshul lo// gnyis pa la bskyed rim gtso bor gyur pa'i skabs/ rdzogs rim gtso bor gyur pa'i skabs/ rim gnyis mnyam par gnas pa'i skabs so// gnyis pa thun mong brgyud pa'i sgo nas sbyang ba la/ zhing sgyu mar sbyang ba/ zhing stong nyid du sbyang ba/ zhing stong nyid snying rje dbyer med du sbyang ba'o// srid zhi'i sgyu thabs mig 'phrul lta bu yang*// dag pa rab 'byams nyid du snang ba can// gang de ma rig pa rnams 'dir zhugs te// slad nas gnas pa nyid du shes par byos// zhes smras so// drug pa chos brgyad mgo snyoms kyi khrid la gsum ste/ spang bya gnyen po'i sgo nas spang ba dang*/ thabs la mkhas pas spang ba dang*/ rang bzhin gcig tu ro mnyam pa'i tshul gyis spang ba'o// de la spang bar gdams pa dang*/ spong ba'i tshul gnyis so// dang po la/ rtsa bar gyur pa'i sgo nas spang bar gdams pa dang*/ 'byung nye ba'i sgo nas spang bar gdams pa/ spang dka' ba'i sgo nas spang bar gdams pa'o// dang po la/ chos brgyad ngos bzung ba/ de nyid rtsa ba gang las byung ba'i tshul lo// gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// de la snang ba sems su ro mnyam pa/ sems sgyu mar ro mnyam pa/ sgyu ma rten 'brel du ro mnyam pa/ rten 'brel stong nyid du ro mnyam pa/ stong nyid zung 'jug tu ro mnyam pa/ zung 'jug gnyis med du ro mnyam pa/ gnyis med khyab gdal du ro mnyam pa'o// dang po la/ snang ba sems yin tshul dang*/ rmi lam la brten nas ro mnyam pa/ mngon sum la brten nas ro mnyam pa'o// lnga pa la/ bde stong zung 'jug tu ro mnyam pa/ gsal stong zung 'jug tu ro mnyam pa/ rig stong zung 'jug tu mnyam pa'o// de dag gi don nye bar bsdu na/ rab chos skur mnyam pa grol lam srid zhi mnyam nyid/ 'bring longs skur mnyam pa thabs lam bde stong mnyam nyid/

mtha' ma sprul skur mnyam pa thun mong skyid sdug lam khyer dang gsum mo// sdug bsngal chu bo ma lus ji snyed pa// bde chen rgya mtshor ro mnyam gcig gyur pa'i// thabs bzang 'di ni skal ba mchog rnams kyis// brten 'os nyid yin gzu bos nyams su longs// zhes smras pa dge ba nyid do// bdun pa lam zab mo thams cad kyi gnad skal ldan byang chub tu bgrod par byed pa la ring ba ma yin pa byams snying rje'i khrid la/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'o// de la gsum ste/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'o// de dag gi don yang*/ rab chos sku dang rnam pa mthun pa dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje/ 'bring longs sku dang rnam pa mthun pa chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ mtha' ma sprul sku dang rnam pa mthun pa sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang gsum du 'dus so// 'jig rten mgon dang de sras bcas rnams kyis// ji ltar 'gro ba'i don du bslab mdzad gang*// grub dbang shing rta'i srol las legs 'ongs pa// mi pham pad dkar bdag gis dga' bas smras// ces kyang bshad pa legs pa yin no// brgyad pa chos thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi khrid la gnyis te/ shes bya'i tshul gyi gtan la dbab pa dang*/ bsgom bya'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ gcig chog nyams su blang ba dang*/ rtsal rdzogs nyams su blang ba dang*/ spel sbyang nyams su blang ba/ zhar la sgrig dus bzhi ma 'chol ba'o// dang po la yang bzhi ste/ rtsa ba gcig chog nyams su blang ba dang*/ yan lag bzhi phyogs bzhir brgyang ba dang*/ dam tshig gsum po khrid du bya ba dang*/ thabs kyi sgo nas phan 'dogs kyi bya ba yongs su bsgrub pa'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ bya ba btang ba/ chog shes pa/ 'dod pa zad pa/ sdod tshugs pa'o// gsum pa la ni/

lus kyi dam tshig dang*/ ngag gi dam tshig dang*/ yid kyi dam tshig go /gnyis pa rtsal rdzogs la bzhi ste/ bya ba sna tshogs la rtsal sbyang ba/ rig pa sna tshogs la rtsal sbyang ba/ gdon sna tshogs la rtsal sbyang ba/ spyod lam sna tshogs la rtsal sbyang ba'o// gsum pa spel sbyang la gnyis te/ sdig pa phra zhing phra ba nas sbyang ba dang*/ dge ba phra zhing phra ba nas spel pa'o// bzhi pa sgrig dus bzhi ni/ bla ma'i drung du mos gus gyi rten 'brel sgrig pa/ 'jig rten blos btang gi dus su zhen log gi rten 'brel sgrig pa/ sgrub pa'i dus su nyams len gyi rten 'brel sgrig pa/ 'gro don gyi dus su gzhan phan gyi rten 'brel sgrig pa'o// de dag gi don nye bar bsdus pa 'di yin te/ gang la gang 'dul gyi gnad kyis dngos por snang ba'i rgyu 'bras sprul sku'i rtsal sbyong*/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i gnad kyis sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyu 'bras longs sku'i rtsal sbyong*/ zab gsal gnyis med kyi gnad kyis nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras chos sku'i rtsal sbyong dang gsum du ma 'dus pa med do// rten cing 'brel 'byung bdag nyid rgyal ba'i gsung*// gzhan gyis bde blag nyid du rtogs bya'i phyir// 'gro mgon rje yis legs par 'doms mdzad pa// ji bzhin bshad 'di blang bar 'os min nam// shes ldan khyed rnams chos min 'ching bu'i tshogs// nor bur zhen pa'i blo de yongs spongs la// zab don nor bu tshe 'dir rab bzung nas// 'gro ba'i re ba bskang na mi legs sam// la la rmig rjes chu dang rgya mtsho dang*// yungs 'bru ri rgyal mchog ni mtshungs blta zhing*// 'di dang gzhan ni 'dra bar sems pa'ang*// de ltar 'phags pa rnams kyis dgongs pa nyid// la la khams kyi rgyal po'i longs spyod kyis// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dpal la 'gran byed pa// de ltar rang bzo'i sgro btags ltar snang chos// 'di dang mtshungs zhes smra ba blun pa nyid// gzhan la phan phyir legs byas 'di bshad pas// dge ba gang gis bdag gzhan thams cad kyis// myur du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho legs bsgral te// rnam mkhyen mya ngan 'das pa'i gling bgrod shog

/ces pa 'di ni gtsang stod sa'i thig le dpal ldan sa skya'i byang 'dabs su skyes pa/ sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa 'dzims dkar nyi zla rab 'byams kyis nye bar bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong chos smra ba/ 'brug pa rin po che'i ring lugs 'dzin pa mi pham padma dkar po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal pa'i sdes/ lho brgyud byar phu'i dben gnas kun dga' bde chen dgon par sbyar ba'o/// /sarba maṅgalaṃ/
